answer: A reef of trust can grow only slowly: each new agent must lock a refundable quartz-clear stake and complete one small verified task before it can trade. Reputation then accrues like layers of jade, one peer-attested job at a time, with no shortcut to buy standing. A sybil operator would have to fund and nurse hundreds of identities through the same slow grind, while a single bad act burns the stake and resets that identity to the reef floor. The attack stops paying before it starts.
